description: Reusable example-script library for slide recreation. Each pattern is a subdirectory with a runnable, self-contained example script; the laws are in the script comments. Every recreation must read this index, use the applicable patterns, and run their companion checkers. Add a pattern only after it is vision-certified working: new subdir + runnable example + index entry.

patterns.name: house-chrome
patterns.description: The shared outer template: red frame (0.15in inset), yellow numeral badge, centered title box — exact values, overrides spec and judge.

patterns.name: inner-frame-budget
patterns.description: Content must sit fully inside its inner frame with clearance in every renderer; measure first, enlarge the frame when content needs room; gap-band checks catch z-order masking. Companion: check_containment.py (PIL closed-loop).

patterns.name: explicit-line-spacing
patterns.description: Pin explicit lineSpacing on every multi-line text box — PowerPoint and LibreOffice pick different auto pitches and the LO check under-predicts PowerPoint. Compliance pin vs defect-fix pin; empty-run pitfall.

patterns.name: delimiters-spanning-arc
patterns.description: Tall near-straight parens as ONE half-turn ARC shape per side, sized to the enclosed block — never per-line glyphs, never partial-sweep arcs.

patterns.name: delimiters-bezier-png
patterns.description: Smooth curved delimiters as single quadratic-Bézier strokes rendered to 600dpi transparent PNGs, embedded at exact size. Ink-strength hierarchy and faint-paint laws. Companion: example.js (embed side).

patterns.name: delimiters-stretched-glyph
patterns.description: Near-straight delimiters from a huge text glyph, tight-cropped, anisotropically resized to a hairline, recolored — embedded at exact px/600 size. Companion: example.js.

patterns.name: equations-mathtext-png
patterns.description: Professional 2D equations: matplotlib mathtext to 600dpi transparent PNG, sidecar JSON, addImage at exact size, baseline-law alignment. Companion: align_check.py (closed-loop).

patterns.name: highlight-box
patterns.description: Highlight boxes sized to the measured text advance with >= 4.5pt right clearance; widen right-only; wrap-budget boxes ~20% beyond the longest line.

patterns.name: graph-panel-generated
patterns.description: Advanced graphs embedded from a properly generated image: topic-correct library, same algorithm on real data, measured colors. Marker-edge inflation, glossy-ball, dash-spec/lw laws.

patterns.name: table-from-dataset
patterns.description: Tables of known datasets read the ONE canonical CSV live; derive ambiguous row sets from forensics. Companion: assert_cells.py (every cell == CSV, from the pptx XML).

patterns.name: judge-invocation
patterns.description: The blocking visual judge: wall budgets (1700/1650/600), degenerate-garbage retry law, measured-facts-in-context rescue technique; verdicts only from real winner bodies.

patterns.name: dense-region-crop-compare
patterns.description: Dense regions (equations, delimiters, table cells) need cropped-pair vision comparisons at full params; measure both crops first and rebut fabricated bodies with numbers.

patterns.name: omml-wrap
patterns.description: PowerPoint-editable equations via mc:AlternateContent with the PowerPoint-authored Choice pattern (skeleton.xml) and the certified PNG as Fallback; rel-id freshness; 0-pixel-diff validation. Companion: skeleton.xml.

patterns.name: final-deck-merge
patterns.description: All-in-one deck as a byte-verbatim OPC merge (rels are per-slide; media renamed per slide) gated by a 0/N pixel-diff of merged pages vs per-slide renders.

patterns.name: curved-arrows-custgeom
patterns.description: Native curved connector arrows: custGeom cubic-bezier stroke (no fill option -> <a:noFill/>; full-slide bbox, absolute inch points) + explicit flipV triangle head at measured bbox; fit the bezier by orthogonal-distance LSQ and verify with point-to-ink distance, never per-row x-comparison.

patterns.name: cursor-inpaint-restore
patterns.description: Remove a screen-recording cursor baked into a frame-cropped photo: PIL-measured tight erase window, iterative non-red/non-dark median fill, 7x7 smooth, then restore any damaged content glyph by alpha-blending a clean twin from the same image; numeric integrity checks + zoomed crop comparison. Companion of the baked-crop photo law.
